name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Lebanon IN

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed white-roofed DC building (Building 7, ~589,616 SF, 49.19-acre parcel per LoopNet) at 135 S Mount Zion Rd, in the Lebanon/Boone County logistics corridor immediately SW of I-65. Building runs NW-SE parallel to the interstate.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate or checkpoint pinch-point visible at the SW truck driveway or the SE car entrance in current Maxar satellite imagery. Driveways are open paved approaches. Street View is 2013 (pre-construction) so cannot corroborate; marked false at high-confidence-from-satellite, listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small staffed booth structure visible at either the SW truck entrance or the SE entrance.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide SW yard drive runs the full length of the dock face; ample room to stack 3+ trucks between the public road and the dock apron.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open paved truck yard apron on the SW side with unused width; room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~50-60 dock positions along the SW face with trailers backed in across multiple sections; banded 50+. Roof HVAC clutter and shadow reduce precision.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Row of ~10+ parked trailers along the NW end plus trailers staged along the SW yard drive constitute a dedicated drop/storage area.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the nearest rail is unrelated.
fieldNotes.expansion: GXO announced an $11M expansion (spring 2025 start, Q4 2027 completion); a graded/cleared pad is visible at the SW corner consistent with planned expansion.
